name: Webclaw OSS Program
description: webclaw for OSS gives open-source builders 100,000 free web-scraping credits a month, a feature on webclaw.io, and a direct line to the team. You ship the tool. Your users find webclaw.

perks.title: 100,000 credits / month
perks.description: The same monthly credits as the Growth plan, free, while your project stays active. Scrape, crawl, search, and extract without watching a meter.

perks.title: We feature your project
perks.description: Your logo and repo link on webclaw.io and on our social channels, in front of developers looking for exactly what you built.

perks.title: Priority support
perks.description: A direct line to the team on Discord. Bugs and feature requests from OSS builders jump the queue.

perks.title: It renews
perks.description: The grant renews each month while your project stays active and the integration stays documented. No re-application.

eligibility:
Public and open source
A public repository under an OSI-approved license. Any language, any framework.

A real webclaw integration
Your tool calls webclaw as part of what it does: a loader, an MCP server, a template, an action, a CLI.

Actively maintained
Recent commits, a real README, someone home. We fund living projects.

Built for other people to use
The strongest fit puts webclaw in front of your own users: something people install, clone, or run.
